title: Zesty Ukrainian Pistachio Soup
description: A light, citrusinfused soup featuring ground pistachios as a silky thickener, perfect for a lowcalorie solo dinner.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the diced onion and sauté until translucent, about 3 minutes.
Stir in the minced garlic, grated carrot, and sliced celery; cook for another 4 minutes until the vegetables soften.
Pour in the vegetable broth and water, bring to a simmer.
Add cumin, paprika, ground pistachios, and a pinch of salt and pepper; stir well.
Let the soup simmer, uncovered, for 12–15 minutes, allowing the pistachios to act as a natural thickener.
While the soup simmers, zest the lemon, then squeeze the juice into a small bowl.
When the soup is nearly done, stir in the lemon zest, lemon juice, and chopped dill.
Taste and adjust seasoning with additional salt, pepper, or lemon juice if desired.
Serve hot, optionally garnished with a swirl of extra dill.
